entries: Quick Job and related matchmaking options are designed to place a player into available Jobs without manually browsing every activity. The exact menus differ by platform and game version.

Freemode work happens inside the shared session rather than a separate Job instance. Businesses, Organizations, Motorcycle Clubs, properties, and contacts can all provide different Freemode activities.
GTA Online includes repeatable Freemode Odd Jobs such as Taxi Work and other activities introduced over time. Recent updates group Odd Jobs more clearly on the map and in menu filters.

The Original Heists are The Fleeca Job, The Prison Break, The Humane Labs Raid, Series A Funding, and The Pacific Standard Job. They use the classic apartment Heist structure with setup missions leading to a finale.
High-end apartments are classic GTA Online properties with garages and Heist planning rooms used for the Original Heists. Some newer content no longer uses apartment planning boards.
The Doomsday Heist is a multi-act Heist line built around the Facility property. Its major finales are The Data Breaches, The Bogdan Problem, and The Doomsday Scenario.
The Diamond Casino Heist is planned from an owned Arcade. It supports three approaches: Aggressive, The Big Con, and Silent & Sneaky, with Prep work and crew choices affecting the finale.
The Cayo Perico Heist centers on infiltrating El Rubio's island. Its planning and Prep flow is tied to the Kosatka submarine, and it supports different infiltration choices and target routes.

The Kortz Center Heist was added in 2026. Players who add an Art Studio to an owned Mansion can run Prep Missions and a 1–4 player finale to steal artwork, then sell it or display it in their Mansion.

The Arcade is both a business property with playable arcade cabinets and the planning base for The Diamond Casino Heist. More installed arcade games increase the property's arcade income.
The Casino Penthouse is a customizable property at The Diamond Casino & Resort. Ownership provides VIP access and Casino-related Story and Freemode content, along with optional rooms and services.
The Kosatka is the submarine property used as the operational base for The Cayo Perico Heist. It also supports its own service features and vehicle options depending on purchased upgrades.

The Facility is the property tied to The Doomsday Heist and several advanced service systems. It also supports storage or access for certain large vehicles and equipment depending on ownership and upgrades.
Buying an Executive Office gives the owner CEO access and SecuroServ business systems. CEOs can run Organization activities and use Office-related services and cargo businesses.
Special Cargo is a CEO business run through the Office's SecuroServ network. Players source crates into owned Warehouses and later sell stored cargo.
Special Cargo Warehouses store CEO cargo. Rockstar introduced small, medium, and large Warehouse capacities, and the Office network is used to source and sell that cargo.

Buying a Clubhouse lets the owner become an MC President, invite members, run Club work and contracts, and access Biker business systems. MC roles include positions such as Prospect, Road Captain, and Vice President.

The classic Biker businesses are Cocaine, Meth, Counterfeit Cash, Weed, and Document Forgery operations. They use supplies to produce sellable product and can be upgraded with equipment, staff, and security.
The Bunker runs the Gunrunning business. Its Disruption Logistics computer manages resupply, weapon production, research, staff allocation, sales, and Bunker upgrades.

The Mobile Operations Center is a configurable truck-and-trailer service vehicle unlocked through Bunker ownership. Its bays can support functions such as weapon work, weaponized-vehicle modification, storage, living quarters, and Mobile Operations.
Hangars provide aircraft storage and access to Air Freight Cargo or smuggling content. Later updates expanded Hangar-related storage and missions.

The Nightclub combines a public club with business management. Its popularity system supports club income, while its warehouse side can use technicians to accumulate goods linked to eligible owned businesses.

The Terrorbyte is a large service vehicle associated with the Nightclub era. GTA Online uses it for mobile operations and service functions, and newer updates add further Terrorbyte upgrades through properties such as the Garment Factory.
The Auto Shop supports robbery-style Contracts, customer vehicle repair and delivery work, and Exotic Exports after the required progression. It was introduced with Los Santos Tuners.
The LS Car Meet is a social car space where players can display, modify, test, and race vehicles. It also has its own membership, reputation system, race content, and vehicle-focused features.
